Q5217.reason: The catalog was only an invitation and the PO was the offer. Costco's acceptance was expressly conditional on the loading charge, so under UCC 2-207(1) it was a counteroffer that Rainmaking never accepted, and no contract formed.

Q6156.reason: The engineer is unavailable, and the company deposed him with both the opportunity and a similar motive to challenge his claim that the safety reports were false, so FRE 804(b)(1) former testimony applies.

Q8413.reason: In Al-Adsani v. UK the Court held, 9 to 8, that granting state immunity was a proportionate restriction and did not violate Article 6, so immunity prevailed over the right of access to court.
